title: Horizon Robotics
summary: China's leading supplier of automotive AI chips and driving software.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Horizon designs the Journey series of automotive processors and the accompanying software stack, and listed in Hong Kong in 2024. Its newest generation targets highway and city navigation-assisted driving at volume price points, competing with Nvidia, Mobileye and in-house programmes at Chinese automakers. Revenue depends on a handful of vehicle programmes, so design wins matter more than headline TOPS.

Technology Exposure

  • ADAS and navigation-assisted driving compute.
  • Software tooling for automakers building on Journey chips.

What To Watch

  • Number of production vehicle programmes per chip generation.
  • Price pressure from Nvidia's scaled-down China products.

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 18 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.

businessMeaning: For automakers, the chip choice locks in a software stack for a vehicle lifetime; switching costs are the real moat.
investmentLens: Design-win backlog is the leading indicator; reported revenue lags it by roughly two years.
